support_claim_rule: Only compatibility backed by completed CI/release qualification evidence may be presented as tested support.

class_files.notes: The class-file workflow compiles one neutral fixture at every listed Java release, transforms each class file with the same Bridge source build under host JDK 21 and 26, preserves the class major, validates the Bridge run report, verifies with the JDK Class-File API, runs -Xverify:all, and executes the transformed class on JDK 26. A target is tested support only when the relevant qualification run has completed successfully.

verification.jdk_classfile_api_verifier: scripts/VerifyClassFiles.java on JDK 25+ compatibility lanes and class-file qualification output
verification.jvm_verify_all: bridge-test Surefire and class-file execution use -Xverify:all
verification.behavioral_execution: bridge-test advertised-feature suite runs on host lanes; class-file qualification executes every transformed release fixture
